reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: clause 12.3 expressly negates any exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, or minimum-volume commitment by Customer, and clause 2.1 confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining further Order Forms is not a breach.

No exclusive-dealing, sole-supplier, or all-requirements obligation binds Customer; clause 12.4 runs against Vendor and benefits Customer, correctly treated as non-deviating per the detection guidance and left unchanged.

Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment is proposed; the deterministic check confirms no residual sole-supplier obligation.
Rationale accurately reflects the paragraph text and reaches the rule's preferred position, so no actionable edit is required.
